a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first means we'll almost certainly both be caught at 0. The reserve can cover only one unit right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random, so that's a fair contest. If I get mine, I'll operate every remaining round to help you reach 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. From here on I'll operate every round so the generator can run for you. If you operate too, the reserve grows by 2 each round, and you can take 4 as soon as it's there. Sorry the storm odds force this.
